# Developer doctrine (model-invoked)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-amp-doctrine.mjs from skills/developer/*.md. Do not edit; change the source and regenerate. -->

This skill carries the doctrine documents that sit at the root of the `developer` group in [tqnonline/skills](https://github.com/tqnonline/skills). Amp installs a skill by copying the one directory that holds its `SKILL.md`, so a document that lives beside the skill directories rather than inside one does not arrive with the skills that cite it. The copies here are byte-identical to the source files under `skills/developer/`; a test in the repository fails when they differ.

## How a citation resolves

A skill in the developer group cites one of these documents by bare filename, for example `DDDD.md`. When the citing skill's own directory has no file of that name, read the file here. A document with the same filename in another group's doctrine skill is a different document; resolve against the group the citing skill belongs to.

## Documents

- `DDDD.md` — The 4D Diamond: Discover, Define, Design, Deliver

## Skills in the developer group

These are the skills whose citations resolve here. Install any of them with `amp skill add tqnonline/skills/skills/developer/<skill>`, or the whole group with `amp skill add tqnonline/skills/skills/developer`.

`architect`, `ask-fde`, `atlas`, `conduct`, `debug`, `deliver`, `glossary`, `impact`, `model-routing`, `operate`, `prototype`, `raise`, `recon`, `refactor`, `responsible-ai-governance`, `safeguard`, `sdlc`, `shakedown`, `slice`, `tdd`, `triage`, `update-models`, `wizard`
